items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I knew of him. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: He was with Doc Cook for a long time. Your mother Doc Cook.
Yeah, I knew Doc Cook. He was from here, I think, with him.
I don't think. Well, anyhow, he used to. He had a lot of New Orleans fellas.
